name: Harriman
bio: Harriman passed through in May 1884 claiming to be walking from Duluth to San Francisco and to be a champion six-day pedestrian. The paper soon called him exposed as a tramp who rode freight trains.

moments.label: Exposed by the paper as a tramp, not a walker
